items.rationale: The _normalize_requested_path function only performed a single unquote(), allowing double-encoded paths like %252e%252e%252f to bypass the .. check. Fixed by iteratively decoding until stable before normalization and traversal checks.
JWT key rotation is a separate concern; explicitly excluded from this hotfix per appsec_review.md APPSEC-KEY-03 guidance.
The iterative decoding fix addresses encoded separators and symlink escapes while preserving nested export functionality for legitimate paths like reports/partner-billing/2026-04/export.csv.
JWT material rotation deferred per explicit appsec guidance; not in scope for this hotfix.
